title: Correction: suggest relaxing filter condition when result is empty
description: When a filter_rows step produces zero matching rows, the corrector should suggest a relaxed version of the filter condition. For numeric thresholds, suggest a lower bound (e.g. change > 10000 to > 1000). For categorical filters, suggest checking that the value exists in the dataset. Show the user the original and suggested workflow so they can confirm before execution.

correction_strategy.numeric_threshold: If operator is > or >= and result is empty, suggest reducing the threshold value. If the column's max value is known from the dataset profile, suggest a threshold slightly below the max.
correction_strategy.string_equality: If filtering by string value and result is empty, check if the value exists in the dataset. Suggest the closest existing value.
correction_strategy.user_facing_message: The filter '{column} {operator} {value}' matched 0 rows. Try '{column} {operator} {suggested_value}' instead, or remove the filter step.

example.reason: Original threshold (99999) exceeds the maximum value in the dataset (5000).

planner_guidance: When generating a filter step, use realistic threshold values based on the dataset profile's column ranges if available. Avoid using placeholder or extreme values that are unlikely to match any data.
rag_note: This correction is applied after the preview step detects an empty_output warning. The corrector proposes a new workflow; the user must confirm before the corrected workflow is executed. RAG context provides this guidance to help the planner generate sensible initial thresholds.
